events.event_name: A Drop of Japan: Apothékary x SUKOSHI Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: Three-day Japanese-wellness pop-up with tongue readings, product sampling, ingredient education and kakigori.
events.what_is_free: Product samples and kakigori while supplies last; the first 50 guests each day receive a mini Apothékary tincture.
events.caveats: Apothékary's current event listing provides an RSVP path. The first-50 mini tincture and kakigori are supply-limited. A 20% event discount and gift-with-purchase are separate from free admission/sampling.
events.practical_notes: Friday Sept. 18 runs 1–9 PM; Saturday and Sunday Sept. 19–20 run 9 AM–9 PM.

events.event_name: Happy Camp3r: The Sweetest Stop in NYC
events.what_it_is: Happy Camp3r's first NYC retail pop-up with new styles, sweet treats, photo moments, exclusive experiences and surprises.
events.what_is_free: Public admission; promotional treats or surprises may be offered while supplies last.
events.caveats: The public shopping pop-up is open to the public. Do not treat the separate Sept. 17 preview/invite as the admission rule for the Sept. 18–20 public run.
events.practical_notes: Public run: Sept. 18–20, 10 AM–6 PM daily at 251 Elizabeth Street.

events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: YEPODA K-Beauty Pop-Up — Sephora Meatpacking
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty activation outside Sephora Meatpacking with product trials, gifts and prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: No purchase is necessary to attend or receive freebies; exclusive gifts are while supplies last. Guests can also enter to win Sephora gift cards and full-size products.
events.caveats: The organizer provides a free Eventbrite registration page, but its public description explicitly says no purchase is necessary to attend and does not establish organizer approval. Free gifts are not guaranteed and are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, noon–6 PM, on 13th Street in front of Sephora Meatpacking.

events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: YEPODA K-Beauty Pop-Up — Sephora Union Square
events.what_it_is: Yepoda's K-beauty activation outside Sephora Union Square with product trials, gifts and prize opportunities.
events.what_is_free: No purchase is necessary to attend or receive freebies; exclusive gifts are while supplies last. Guests can also enter to win Sephora gift cards and full-size products.
events.caveats: The organizer provides a free Eventbrite registration page, but its public description explicitly says no purchase is necessary to attend and does not establish organizer approval. Free gifts are not guaranteed and are while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, noon–6 PM, on Broadway between East 13th and East 12th Streets by Sephora Union Square.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum x Macy's Sampling
events.what_it_is: Open-air Max Mara Le Parfum launch activation outside Macy's with scent discovery, games, photo moments and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary fragrance samples, gelato and promotional giveaways while supplies last.
events.caveats: Max Mara provides an Eventbrite ticket page, while current event descriptions also invite the public to stop by the open-air plaza activation. No organizer-selection/approval step is established. Samples, gelato and prizes are supply-limited.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM–6 PM at Macy's Herald Square Plaza.

events.event_name: Brown Bee x Pura Vida Pop-Up
events.what_it_is: Two-day Brown Bee collaboration pop-up at Pura Vida Nolita.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests can receive a PB smoothie, a full-size product and an exclusive Brown Bee gift.
events.caveats: Current listings describe this as open to the public. The first-100 giveaway is supply- and arrival-order-dependent; do not imply every visitor receives it.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18–19, 10 AM–6 PM daily at Pura Vida Nolita, 98 Kenmare Street.

events.address: Center Plaza, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10112
events.what_it_is: Cj Hendry's large-scale plush Flower Market returning to Rockefeller Center with NYC-native flower designs.
events.what_is_free: Entry is free and every guest receives a first plush flower free, subject to flower availability. Additional flowers cost $5.
events.caveats: Flower Market itself is free and open to the public. Hours are subject to change based on flower availability. A paid Top of the Rock Flower Market Express ticket provides expedited entry but is not required for ordinary admission.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 24: 1–8 PM. Sept. 25–27: 10 AM–8 PM daily. Center Plaza at Rockefeller Center.
